name: Convex Grid Topological Visibility Sorting
definition: An O(n) visibility sorting algorithm for a convex grid of convex cells, based on pairwise ordering relations between cells sharing a common face.
summary: Convex Grid Topological Visibility Sorting is an O(n) algorithm that orders convex polyhedral cells back-to-front for volume rendering by performing a topological sort on a directed adjacency graph derived from local face-sharing topology.
